# SCI-FRUIT v0.1 — Iterative Feedback, State, And Termination

Status: generic SCI-FRUIT-NORMATIVE-CORE v0.1/r0.4 accepted and conditionally
frozen; ordinary-MAP scope r0.2 approved, with concrete paper method/boundary
proposal r0.1 prepared for owner review.
Every numerical method/route remains unavailable pending separate approval.
Updated: 2026-09-08.

## Program Adherence And Prior-Work Recovery

This package follows the [program charter](../../../README.md),
[accepted pilot workflow](../../../PILOT_PROCESS_REVIEW_2026-08-16.md) and
[downstream roadmap](../../../DOWNSTREAM_CONTRACT_ROADMAP_2026-08-26.md).
The [current method recovery](method_preparation/ordinary_map/method_definition/r0.1/PRIOR_WORK.md)
adopts the exact frozen generic FRUIT core and inherited PTC/MAP science,
identifies both sides of the PTC boundary, and defers empirical evidence.
Implementation/configuration and the internal dossier remain outside independent
authorship. New work is one exact method proposal and its upstream permissions;
no generic FRUIT or PCA derivation is repeated.

The [scope approval](method_preparation/ordinary_map/method_definition/r0.1/OWNER_SCOPE_APPROVAL_2026-09-08.md)
closes D001–D005 as scope and paper-preparation directions. The
[current source control](method_preparation/ordinary_map/method_definition/r0.1/REFERENCE_CONTROL.md)
reconciles the three process-only reference flags; any later exact sanitized
author packet and dispatch still require separate approval.
The generic-core program-order exception permits
conditional-core authorship before numerical-method qualification; it grants
no numerical method or new method-specific author dispatch.

- [Exact generic-core conditional freeze](scientific_core/SCI_FRUIT_STAGE_B_R0.4_OWNER_CONDITIONAL_FREEZE_2026-09-08.md)

The approved scope is compact-source pointing with one observation, separately
identified array bundles and unfiltered normalized ordinary MAP feedback.
The concrete candidate proposes support-only model selection, matched
containing-pixel removal/rejoin, a bootstrap-fitted PTC operator then held fixed,
and a new uniform analysis/gridding family retained with current compatibility
and QC. These are proposed method rules, not numerical approvals.

The current route is `unavailable_under_current_frozen_parent_permissions`:
residual PTC admission and rejoined-child MAP admission require precise
controlled successors. Coefficient-family, PTC-plan and numerical MAP support
bindings are also missing. Frozen MAP stays v0.1/r0.7.1; no successor is adopted.
The next significant review is the concrete method and named boundary actions,
not another scope cycle. Historical JINC control and all prior packets remain
unchanged. No experiment design, execution or author dispatch is authorized here.
Stage A and the Stage B r0.4 core/delivery remain unchanged. Earlier pending
review and not-launched wording in historical packets is historical status.
